findings.text: The docs model card is a product page (specs, features, weights, deprecation), not a safety or evaluation report.

source.quote: Our top-tier large model for high-complexity tasks with the lastest version released November 2024.

findings.text: The card marks the model deprecated and points new integrations to Mistral Medium 3.5, with deprecation date 2/27/2026.

source.quote: This model is deprecated. Use Mistral Medium 3.5 for new integrations.

findings.text: Open weights are listed under Mistral Research License (MRL) with 123B total and 123B active parameters.

notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mistral-large-2-1-24-11). Product/catalog page only: header date, context 128k, MRL badge, Weights table params 123/123 and context 128k, modality tooltips Text input and Text output, features, deprecation. No risk tiers, safety topics, or numeric eval tables. Specs from page HTML/RSC (header badges, modality tooltips, Weights tab in RSC; the Weights tab panel is empty in static HTML but row data is in the flight payload). Linked blog https://mistral.ai/news/pixtral-large (seed key mistral-pixtral-large-blog) mentions Large 24.11 upgrades but was not used; seed-lookup listed only this document. legal.mistral.ai governance page also not used. Header date treated as releaseDate like other Mistral docs cards; description also says released November 2024. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty.
